start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:turn-notes-into-finished-content with format 'thread' for pursuit:example-bakery, from these notes: 'I used to write the order sheet from scratch every morning. Now I hand a new baker the sheet from yesterday and they learn the bake in one morning.'"
no_lists_because: The notes come in as input and are searched in the person's own files, and the finished draft is kept as a file under /Content/, so it reads and writes no list.
instructions: 1. Have your notes, words or principle ready word for word (at least 20 characters) and decide the format (the id or name of one of your content formats, such as a post, thread, newsletter, article, script or talk).
2. Say "Run workflow:turn-notes-into-finished-content" with material, format and, if there is one, pursuit.

3. Step own-work searches your files for what you have already said and keeps your exact words and where each was found; step story runs workflow:method-tell-a-story to the end and hands back its run_id and the core change.
4. Steps write and laws write the piece citing your own words and check every line against your copywriting laws (workflow:write-product-words when you have none) and aloud.

5. Step judge runs tool:check-copy on the draft until it passes, keeps the draft in your files under /Content/ and links it to its pursuit; read the final draft and where it was kept before you use it.
